title: Do Large Language Models Know What They Don't Know II? A Fully Behavioral, Non-Cognitive Measure of Epistemic Honesty
abstract: arXiv:2609.07879v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are frequently confident, eloquent, and well versed. A natural question arises: do they know what they don't know? To answer this question, we borrow the concept of epistemic honesty and develop a novel metric to systematically evaluate whether an LLM appropriately acknowledges the boundaries of its knowledge. In this work, we introduce the Epistemic Honesty Quotient (EHQ), which reports three observable sub-scores across two operational axes (epistemic restraint and substantive-answer calibration), and construct EHQ-3000, a 3,000-question benchmark spanning Fabricated Entity, Post-Cutoff Event, Hyper-Niche True, and Context-Conditioned Questions. From a frozen registry of 21 model API routes, 15 completed the protocol after endpoint and eligibility checks; 14 entered the confirmatory analysis because severe provider-side truncation made one route's score indeterminate. The study reveals substantial variation

translated_title: 大语言模型知道自己不知道什么吗（二）？一种完全行为化、非认知的认知诚实度量
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）常常表现得自信、雄辩且知识渊博。一个自然的问题随之而来：它们知道自己不知道什么吗？为了回答这个问题，我们借鉴了认知诚实的概念，并开发了一种新颖的指标来系统地评估大语言模型是否恰当地承认其知识边界。在本工作中，我们提出了认知诚实商数（EHQ），该指标在两个操作维度（认知克制和实质性回答校准）上报告三个可观测的子分数，并构建了EHQ-3000——一个包含3,000个问题的基准，涵盖虚构实体、知识截止日期后事件、超小众真问题和情境条件问题四类问题。从一个包含21个模型API路由的固定注册表中，经过端点和资格检查后，15个完成了协议；由于严重的提供商端截断使其中一个路由的分数无法确定，最终14个进入了验证性分析。该研究揭示了显著的差异
tldr: 本文提出认知诚实商数（EHQ）这一新颖的行为化指标，并构建包含3,000个问题、涵盖四类问题类型的EHQ-3000基准，用于系统评估大语言模型是否恰当地承认自身知识的边界。
